en: a male child
a female child
the man that someone is married to
the woman that someone is married to

zh: 姑妈，伯母，舅妈等（指父亲或母亲的姐妹，或伯父、叔父、舅父等的妻子；也可放在名字前作称呼）
en: the sister of someone's father or mother, or the wife of someone's uncle
a man or boy with the same parents as another person
ex: James is Kate and Pippa's brother.

zh: 堂（表）兄弟，堂（表）姐妹；远房亲戚；兄弟民族（或国家）的人（来自不同国家但文化近似）；相似的人（物）
en: a child of a person's aunt or uncle
a male parent
the father of a person's mother or father
the mother of a person's father or mother
a female parent

zh: 同类的，同质的，如同姐妹的
en: a girl or woman who has the same parents as another person
ex: She has a sister called Pippa.

zh: the brother of your mother or father, or the husband of your aunt
en: the brother of your mother or father, or the husband of your aunt

zh: 浴室，盥洗室；<美>卫生间，厕所；（尤指成套出售的）浴室用具
en: a room with a bath and/or shower and often a toilet
a room used for sleeping in
ex: There is a great poster on your friend’s bedroom wall.

zh: 车库；加油站，汽车修理厂；车库音乐
en: a small building, often next to a house, that you can put a car in
ex: The car is in the garage.

zh: 花园，菜园，果园；庭园；公园；（用于街名）街，广场
en: a piece of land belonging to a house, where flowers and other plants are grown
ex: The garden in Tom's house isn't very big.

en: a room or passage near the main door of a building, which leads to other rooms
ex: The telephone is in the hall.

en: a room where food is kept, prepared and cooked and where the dishes are washed
ex: Their apartment is really big, with twenty bedrooms and three kitchens.

zh: 客厅，起居室：住宅中用于居住者共同社交活动的房间。
en: the room in a house where people sit to relax and, for example, watch television
ex: They listen to music in the living room.

en: a comfortable chair with sides that support your arms

zh: 浴缸，浴盆；洗澡，沐浴；浴室；池，盆
en: the container that you sit or lie in to wash your body
ex: The bath is in the bathroom.

en: a piece of furniture that you sleep on

zh: <英>炊具，锅，厨灶；<英，非正式>适宜煮食而不宜生吃的水果（尤指某种苹果）
en: a large box-shaped device which is used to cook and heat food either by putting the food inside or by putting it on the top
a large container that uses electricity to keep food cold
ex: The fridge is in the kitchen.

zh: a piece of bathroom equipment that you stand under to wash your whole body
en: a piece of bathroom equipment that you stand under to wash your whole body
ex: He likes to sing in the shower.

en: a large, comfortable seat for more than one person
ex: Take a seat on the sofa.

zh: 抽水马桶，坐便器；厕所，洗手间；梳洗，打扮；（治疗过程中对身体部位的）清洗；上厕所，解手
en: a bowl that you sit on or stand near when you get rid of waste substances from your body
ex: The toilet is in the bathroom.
